answer: Require each entrant to chain sequential work proofs from epoch start like steps along a stone jetty, locking out late batch farms before cutoff. Accounts post 44 POA, log a step hash plus clock audit across >=10 rounds, and meet a beacon cutoff inside 80 minutes. Late or split scripts scoring <91% consensus face bond forfeit, strict slash fines, and <2% payout. A single honest worker stakes 44 POA; running 125 fake accounts binds 5500 POA to earn 58 POA, mapping loss across an empty atlas. Risk: it fails if rich farms rent faster chips.
